### Summary

Since no candidate modified any component of the harness, there are no edit rows to report. The trajectory shows the base harness already solved the task correctly on its first attempt with no format violations. The decision notes correctly identified that the library lesson on explicit format instructions (ood-strings-001) did not apply — the LLM already complied with the plain space-separated format without labels or explanation.

The exercise demonstrates sound judgment: recognizing when a task is already solved correctly and rejecting speculative edits that would waste context budget.
